studio.lead: Ravino is an architecture studio working across buildings, interiors, landscape and cities.
body: We start from the site and from the people who will use it. Each project is drawn as a sequence of spaces rather than as an object, and presented the same way: one image at a time, read from one side to the other.

The studio works in Tehran with collaborators in Oslo and Istanbul — for example Atelier Nord on timber structures and Lund & Partners on coastal engineering. Our drawings are produced in BIM (ISO 19650) and our buildings are designed to meet LEED Gold or better.
